strings.The Data Center Services Regulations fro: The Data Center Services Regulations from the Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST) took effect on 1 January 2024. Any provider offering data center services to others in the Kingdom must register each facility with CST. The category you qualify for depends on the certification your facility holds. Standard and Advanced facilities must also be carrier neutral and submit energy management and sustainability plans.
strings.A design certificate alone does not reac: A design certificate alone does not reach the Standard or Advanced category. The built facility has to be certified, and that is where most projects lose time. We plan for the construction audit from the first drawing.
strings.Both schemes rate a facility on four lev: Both schemes rate a facility on four levels, and level three means the same in each: the site can be maintained without shutting down IT. They differ in who issues the certificate, what is audited and how long it lasts.
strings.Not sure which one your project needs? W: Not sure which one your project needs? We compare both against your CST category, your customers' tender terms and your budget, then recommend a route. Some Saudi operators hold one certificate, and some hold both.
